Consistent prospecting, qualified opportunities, effective demos, closed accounts, and new customers who begin shipping—not simply a high volume of outreach.

The Program Coordinator – Staten Island Career Ready will oversee UAU’s Staten Island school-based programming within the Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP) and Work, Learn, and Grow (WLG) programs. The Program Coordinator will ensure the delivery of high-quality programming aligned with UAU policies, Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) guidelines, and Department of Education (DOE) requirements. This position will provide oversight, supervision, and strategic guidance to Staten Island Career Ready Youth Employment Coordinators (YECs), supporting program recruitment, enrollment, orientation, worksite placements, participant engagement, payroll, and compliance. The Program Coordinator will also lead project management, staff training, and technical assistance to ensure program effectiveness, compliance, and the achievement of established goals and performance benchmarks.

**PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to):**  

* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with faculty, staff, administrators, and school-based Work-Based Learning teams at Staten Island DOE Career Ready partner schools.

* Expand UAU’s presence within Staten Island Career Ready schools through participation in school activities, community events, and stakeholder meetings, and oversee the planning and implementation of annual career fairs with partner schools.
* Develop and maintain a centralized database of school contacts, partnership activities, and relevant communications to support coordination across the Workforce team.
* Provide direct supervision, training, and technical assistance to Staten Island YECs, including regular site visits to partner schools, observation of YEC-led workshops, annual performance evaluations, and input on YEC school assignments, ensuring they have the resources, guidance, and support needed to meet program objectives.
* Establish clear staff expectations, performance goals, and deadlines in collaboration with program leadership while promoting accountability and professional development.
* Oversee and support YECs with participant recruitment, enrollment, orientation, and retention for SYEP and WLG programming, including establishing school-level recruitment targets in collaboration with program leadership and reviewing YEC outreach and marketing strategies.
* Monitor enrollment and retention outcomes to ensure contractual targets and DYCD deadlines are met, implementing re-engagement strategies as needed and serving as the escalation point for participant and worksite concerns raised by YECs.
* Lead audit readiness by reviewing and validating YEC peer audits of participant and worksite files and conducting internal reviews to ensure program documentation, participant records, and activities comply with DYCD requirements and UAU policies ahead of DYCD’s formal audit.
* Oversee Project-Based Learning (PBL) and Professional Technical Development (PTD) applications and related participant onboarding, ensuring requirements and deadlines are met.
* Guide YECs in preparing and delivering culminating SYEP presentations that demonstrate program impact and oversee the transition of eligible SYEP participants into WLG.

* Collaborate with the Employment Coordinator to develop internship opportunities aligned with the Career Ready model and participants’ CTE programs of study.
* Collaborate with the Education Coordinator to develop workshops and activities that strengthen participant engagement, career readiness, and workplace skills, and ensure YEC workshops are delivered in person as the primary format, with virtual or asynchronous content (e.g., EdPuzzle) used only when in-person delivery isn’t feasible.
* Coordinate with instructional partners (e.g., ExpandED) and maintain working knowledge of credit-bearing opportunities (e.g., CUNY Reach, the Credit Program, College Now) that intersect with SYEP and WLG programming.
* Facilitate regular team meetings to communicate program updates, monitor progress, address challenges, and ensure alignment across Staten Island Career Ready sites, and coordinate with the Bronx Program
